themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents performing research tasks autonomously, including their capabilities, limitations, and potential risks.

themes.name: AI summarization insights
themes.description: Covers AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for quicker insight extraction.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discusses AI-powered systems designed to facilitate and enhance various stages of the research process.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Explores how AI can be used to analyze customer data and extract actionable insights for business decisions.

themes.name: AI session replay
themes.description: Details the application of AI in analyzing user session replays to understand user behavior and identify UX issues.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Covers the use of AI in supporting product managers with tasks such as feature prioritization, roadmap planning, and market analysis.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Examines AI's role in augmenting the capabilities of designers and researchers in their creative and analytical processes.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to create various forms of content, including text, music, and visual assets.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Addresses the challenges and best practices for managing and integrating multiple AI API keys and tools effectively.

themes.name: AI ethics in research
themes.description: Investigates the ethical considerations and potential misalignments when training AI agents, particularly in research contexts.
